
 Usage: houston [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Launch version-matched Rocket.Chat reproduction environments.

╭─ Options ──╮
 --version  -V        print the installed houston version and exit
 --help               Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
╭─ Commands ──╮
 up             Create and start a version-matched Rocket.Chat repro.
 ready          Block until Rocket.Chat is serving (polls /api/info).
 down           Remove a repro's containers. Keeps data (and the record) unless --volumes.
 monitor        Attach (or --off to detach) Prometheus + Grafana on a running repro.
 prune          Delete every `down` repro — INCLUDING its data volume and record. Skips pinned
                and running ones.
 start          Resume a stopped repro (fast, no rebuild).
 stop           Pause a repro, keeping its containers and data.
 restart        Restart a repro.
 use            Set the default repro for name-less commands.
 list           List all repros with version, port, status and URL.
 info           Show a repro's URL, admin credentials and a curl snippet.
 users          Manage who can sign in to the web GUI.
 edge           The shared Traefik that serves every HTTPS name on this box.
 config         Read or write remembered settings, so they need not be retyped every run.
 env            Show or change a repro's Rocket.Chat environment variables.
 tls-status     Report what is ACTUALLY being served over HTTPS for a repro.
 trust-ca       Install houston's local CA so `--https` repros are trusted without warnings.
 token          Mint an API auth token (X-Auth-Token / X-User-Id headers).
 api            Make an authenticated REST call against a repro and print the response.
 pat            Mint a Personal Access Token and print ready-to-use headers (curl/Postman).
 seed           Populate a repro with sample users, channels, DMs and messages.
 config-import  Apply a customer's exported settings (from a support dump) to a repro.
 backup         Back up a repro's Rocket.Chat database into a restorable bundle.
 backups        List backup bundles in ~/.houston/backups/, newest first.
 restore        Restore a backup bundle into a repro.
 upgrade        Upgrade a RUNNING repro to another Rocket.Chat version.
 stats          Sample a repro's container CPU/RAM (peak over a window, or --watch live).
 loadtest       Drive real HTTP load at a repro with k6 and check it against an SLO.
 capacity       Find how much concurrency a repro sustains before the SLO breaks.
 logs           Tail a repro's logs.
 presets        List available presets.
 versions       Show the resolved MongoDB pairing for a Rocket.Chat version.
 audit          Read the activity trail: who did what, and whether it was allowed.
 chown          Hand a workspace over to somebody else.
 capabilities   What this build can do, as JSON, for an agent or a script.
 doctor         Preflight: check Docker, Compose, disk, connectivity and ports.
 cluster        What a Kubernetes cluster is holding, and what it is costing.
 serve          Launch the web GUI (needs `pip install 'houston[gui]'`).
 skill          Install the agent skill that teaches a caller to drive houston.
╰──╯
